result.topic_en: Tables of fifth-power residues and classes of non-residues modulo the primes 41 and 61, followed by general statements on numbers whose m-th powers leave remainder 1 modulo a prime mn+1, and on the count of m-th power residues.

485. Proposito ergo quocunque divisore primo formae $10p+1$, dabitur numerus $a$, ut $a^5-1$ per eum sit divisibilis, quam proprietatem quoque habebunt numeri $a^2$, $a^3$, $a^4$, quorum potestates quintae etiam unitatem relinquunt. Sequentes termini $a^5$, $a^6$, etc. ab his non sunt diversi, cum sit $a^5=n(10p+1)+1$, sicque $a^5$ ipsi $1$, $a^6$ ipsi $a$, $a^7$ ipsi $a^2$ etc. aequivaleat.

486. Cum quinque numeri, quorum potestates quintae per $10p+1$ divisae unitatem relinquunt, ita repraesentari queant $1$, $a$, $a^2$, $a^3$, $a^4$, si $b^5$ det residuum $\alpha$, quinque habebuntur numeri $b$, $ab$, $a^2b$, $a^3b$, $a^4b$, quorum potestates quintae, per $10p+1$ divisae, idem relinquunt residuum $\alpha$.

487. Quia idem ad altiores potestates extendi potest, proposito quocunque numero primo $mn+1$, semper dabitur numerus $a$, ut $a^m-1$ per eum sit divisibile; ejusque potestates omnes eadem praeditae erunt proprietate. Erit autem $a$ minor quam divisor $mn+1$, talesque numeri diversi tot, quot $m$ continet unitates, exhiberi possunt.

488. Proposito porro divisore primo $mn+1$, si per eum potestates $1^m$, $2^m$, $3^m$, $4^m$, etc. dividantur, usque ad $(mn)^m$, plura residua diversa non relinquentur, quam $n$, ideoque dabuntur $(m-1)n$ numeri divisore minores, qui non sunt residua.

methods.what: If b^5 ≡ α, then b, ab, a^2b, a^3b, a^4b all have fifth powers ≡ α (mod 10p+1)

methods.what: Generalization: for a prime mn+1 there are m distinct numbers less than mn+1 whose m-th powers are ≡ 1
methods.quote: proposito quocunque numero primo $mn+1$, semper dabitur numerus $a$, ut $a^m-1$ per eum sit divisibile; ejusque potestates omnes eadem praeditae erunt proprietate.

methods.what: Modulo a prime mn+1 there are at most n distinct m-th power residues, hence (m-1)n non-residues
methods.quote: plura residua diversa non relinquentur, quam $n$, ideoque dabuntur $(m-1)n$ numeri divisore minores, qui non sunt residua

items.quote: Erit autem $a$ minor quam divisor $mn+1$, talesque numeri diversi tot, quot $m$ continet unitates, exhiberi possunt.
items.english: Moreover a will be less than the divisor mn+1, and as many such distinct numbers can be exhibited as m contains units.

items.quote: proposito quocunque numero primo $mn+1$, semper dabitur numerus $a$, ut $a^m-1$ per eum sit divisibile
items.english: Given any prime number mn+1, there will always be a number a such that a^m − 1 is divisible by it.

items.quote: plura residua diversa non relinquentur, quam $n$, ideoque dabuntur $(m-1)n$ numeri divisore minores, qui non sunt residua
items.english: No more than n distinct residues will be left, and therefore there will be (m−1)n numbers less than the divisor which are not residues.
